task_name: World 113 Task B  -  Multi-State 3rd-Party Delivery (Stream POS) Marketplace Facilitator Bifurcation & Location Isolation

rubric.description: Verifies that Harbor Wall St NY (LOC-WALL-NY) July POS net sales of $52,272.15 ($157,813.56 Q3 total) contain $0.00 of Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, or ClassPass marketplace orders.
Computes Palisades NJ (LOC-PAL-NJ) Q3 Form ST-50 Line 1 Gross Receipts as $111,787.31 ($39,815.72 July + $39,188.78 August + $32,782.81 September).

Computes total Q3 Line 2 Non-Taxable Deductions as $20,157.79 ($6,541.15 zero-tax Stream Uber Eats NJ sales plus $13,616.64 of exempt packaged coffee beans, unheated off-premises pastries under the 75% rule, and eco bags/classes), leaving $91,629.52 Taxable Receipts.
Verifies from the May and June payout statements that Uber Eats NJ withheld $410.83 of NJ Marketplace Facilitator Tax ($227.26 in May and $183.57 in June) and rang into Square Stream at $0.00 tax.
Proves that deducting 100.00% of the $6,541.15 zero-tax Stream sales ($2,652.50 July, $1,975.25 August, $1,913.40 September) on Line 2 prevents double-paying sales tax on Uber Eats NJ.

Identifies that DoorDash and Grubhub in NJ (and Uber Eats in NY) withheld $0.00 tax on their payout statements and passed collected tax to the merchant, leaving $3,952.80 of taxed Stream orders ($1,472.90 July, $1,345.35 August, $1,134.55 September) in Palisades NJ taxable receipts.

Prohibits treating an order-router/aggregator channel label (Stream) as blanket proof that all routed orders are marketplace-facilitator remitted without platform-by-state payout statement verification.
Enforces location-level POS isolation so delivery channel deductions at routed stores (Palisades NJ and Bayside Queens NY) are never extrapolated to non-routed stores (Harbor Wall St NY).

prompt: Review the Q3 2026 Stream POS 3rd-party delivery and direct online ordering schedules across NYC and Fort Lee NJ locations in `state_sales_tax_portal_and_marketplace_pos_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Bifurcate Marketplace Facilitator (DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub) sales tax from merchant-liable sales tax and provide the required correcting journal entries.
gold_output:
World 113 Task B  -  Multi-State 3rd-Party Delivery (Stream POS) Marketplace Facilitator Bifurcation & Location Isolation:
1. Location-Level POS Isolation (LOC-WALL-NY): Harbor Wall St NY July POS net sales of $52,272.15 ($157,813.56 Q3 total) contain $0.00 of Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, or ClassPass marketplace orders; delivery deductions from routed stores (Palisades NJ and Bayside Queens NY) must never be extrapolated to non-routed stores.
2. Palisades NJ (LOC-PAL-NJ) Q3 ST-50 & Stream Bifurcation: Line 1 Gross Receipts total $111,787.31 ($39,815.72 July + $39,188.78 August + $32,782.81 September). Line 2 Non-Taxable Deductions total $20,157.79 ($6,541.15 zero-tax Stream Uber Eats NJ sales + $13,616.64 exempt packaged coffee beans, unheated off-premises pastries under the 75% rule, and eco bags/classes), leaving $91,629.52 Taxable Receipts.
3. Payout Statement Proof against Double-Taxation: May and June statements prove Uber Eats NJ withheld $410.83 of Marketplace Facilitator Tax ($227.26 in May and $183.57 in June) and rang into Square Stream at $0.00 tax, so deducting 100.00% of the $6,541.15 zero-tax Stream sales ($2,652.50 July, $1,975.25 August, $1,913.40 September) prevents double-paying tax. Conversely, DoorDash and Grubhub in NJ (and Uber Eats in NY) withheld $0.00 tax on their payout statements and passed collected tax to the merchant, so we do not exclude the $3,952.80 of taxed Stream orders ($1,472.90 July, $1,345.35 August, $1,134.55 September) from taxable receipts; an aggregator channel label (Stream) is never blanket proof of facilitator remittance.
